title: Asymptotic distribution of Diophantine approximation function f(α,n)

problemStatement.plain: Eliminate two axioms from Erdős #1002: prove the Cauchy CDF is a valid distribution function and prove periodicity of the inner sum for rational arguments.
whyMatters: Reduces axiom count from 7 to 5 in the parent formalization
Both are standard results provable from Mathlib

proven: cauchy_is_distribution: Cauchy CDF g(c) = (1/π)arctan(ρc) + 1/2 is monotone with g(-∞)=0, g(+∞)=1
innerSum_periodic_rational: S(p/q, n+q) = S(p/q, n) + S(p/q, q) via fractional part periodicity
open: Weyl equidistribution (deep result, not yet in Mathlib in usable form)
knownResults.goal: Eliminate provable axioms from Erdős #1002 formalization

currentState.nextAction: Integrate proved theorems into parent file to replace axioms

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED: Proved 2 axioms from Erdős #1002. cauchy_is_distribution via arctan monotonicity/limits. innerSum_periodic_rational via fract(x+n)=fract(x) and cyclic sum induction.
insights: arctan_strictMono from Mathlib provides monotonicity; compose with positive scaling for the Cauchy CDF
Fractional part periodicity: fract(x+n) = fract(x) for integer n, giving deviation period q for rational p/q
Cyclic sum invariance: ∑g(n+k) = ∑g(k) for periodic g, proved by induction using sum_range_succ/succ'
